algorithm: Use the Sieve of Eratosthenes to generate potential primes
Check for primality using the 6*j ± 1 property
Iterate until the ith prime is found
constraints: ith must be a positive integer
n must be within the range -10 to 5000
inputs: n: integer in -10..5000, ith: positive integer
output: int: Return the ith prime greater than n
purpose: Return the ith prime greater than n.
